note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. Both readings are attributed to fictional sources and shown with equal weight; none is marked correct. The hierarchy is supplied by the author and displayed, never applied.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two readers trace one fictional passage onto two overlays on a light table; each overlay highlights the words its attributed reading focuses on, and the overlays are slid apart into two labelled trays.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional passage and readings, a three-row hierarchy, and the author stops the action with both overlays still stacked on the passage (finalState "traced"), so both highlight patterns are held on the one passage.
